record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> How long wilt thou forget<WH07911><WTH8799> me, O LORD<WH03068>? for ever<WH05331>? how long wilt thou hide<WH05641><WTH8686> thy face<WH06440> from me? <RF>chief...: or, overseer<Rf>

How long shall I take<WH07896><WTH8799> counsel<WH06098> in my soul<WH05315>, <FI>having<Fi> sorrow<WH03015> in my heart<WH03824> daily<WH03119>? how long shall mine enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> be exalted<WH07311><WTH8799> over me?

Consider<WH05027><WTH8685> <FI>and<Fi> hear<WH06030><WTH8798> me, O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>: lighten<WH0215><WTH8685> mine eyes<WH05869>, lest I sleep<WH03462><WTH8799> the <FI>sleep of<Fi> death<WH04194>;

Lest mine enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> say<WH0559><WTH8799>, I have prevailed<WH03201><WTH8804> against him; <FI>and<Fi> those that trouble<WH06862> me rejoice<WH01523><WTH8799> when I am moved<WH04131><WTH8735>.
But I have trusted<WH0982><WTH8804> in thy mercy<WH02617>; my heart<WH03820> shall rejoice<WH01523><WTH8799> in thy salvation<WH03444>.
I will sing<WH07891><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068>, because he hath dealt bountifully<WH01580><WTH8804> with me.<CM>
